title: On Growing a row of beans by the wall
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：grow　|　正文 370 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 grow 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the builder ① grew a row of beans by the wall on the same day, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② grows a row of beans by the wall before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ grow a row of beans by the wall at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ grown a row of beans by the wall before — a line in the plan for October 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Growing a row of beans by the wall on the same day, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ grow quieter as the year went on before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Grow quieter as the year went on at once and never mention it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ grows quieter as the year went on on the same day every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ grew a row of beans by the wall again when nobody else would.

⑩ To grow a row of beans by the wall, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody grows a row of beans by the wall before dawn again and somebody must grow a row of beans by the wall on the same day all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 种出（一般过去式 grew a row of beans by the wall：1991 年施工员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 种出（一般现在 grows a row of beans by the wall：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 种出（不定式 to grow a row of beans by the wall：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 种出（过去完成时 had grown a row of beans by the wall：1985 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 种出（动名词 growing a row of beans by the wall 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 变大（grow quieter as the year went on：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去变大一年年过去越来越沉默）
G. v. 变大（grow quieter as the year went on：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 种出（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 grows quieter as the year went on，而母亲又一次 grew a row of beans by the wall）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1991 the builder grew a row of beans by the wall on the same day, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder grows a row of beans by the wall before dawn whenever the site asks.
Growing a row of beans by the wall on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
